text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Go to Pharaoh, and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord , the God of the Hebrews: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“你去见法郎，向他说：上主希伯来人的天主这样说：你应放走我的百姓，叫他们去崇拜我。

text_en: For if you refuse to let them go and still hold them,
text_cn: 你若拒绝不放，仍然扣留他们，

text_en: the hand of the Lord will strike with a deadly pestilence your livestock in the field: the horses, the donkeys, the camels, the herds, and the flocks.
text_cn: 看，上主的手必用一种严厉的瘟疫加在你田野间的一切牲畜：就是马、驴、骆驼、牛、羊身上。

text_en: But the Lord will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt, so that nothing shall die of all that belongs to the Israelites. ’”
text_cn: 上主要分清以色列子民的牲畜和埃及人的牲畜，凡是以色列子民的，一个也不死。

text_en: The Lord set a time, saying, “Tomorrow the Lord will do this thing in the land. ”
text_cn: 上主规定了时间说：明天上主要在此地实行这事。”

text_en: And on the next day the Lord did so; all the livestock of the Egyptians died, but of the livestock of the Israelites not one died.
text_cn: 第二天上主便作了这事。埃及人的牲畜完全死了，但以色列子民的，一个也没有死。

text_en: Pharaoh inquired and found that not one of the livestock of the Israelites was dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he would not let the people go.
text_cn: 法郎打发人去看，果然以色列子民的牲畜，连一个也没有死。但是法郎仍然心硬，不肯放走百姓。

text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, “Take handfuls of soot from the kiln, and let Moses throw it in the air in the sight of Pharaoh.
text_cn: 上主又对梅瑟和亚郎说：“你们满手抓把炉灰，梅瑟要在法郎眼前向天扬起。

text_en: It shall become fine dust all over the land of Egypt, and shall cause festering boils on humans and animals throughout the whole land of Egypt. ”
text_cn: 这灰要在埃及全国变成尘土，使全埃及国的人和牲畜身上生出红疹和脓疮。”

text_en: So they took soot from the kiln, and stood before Pharaoh, and Moses threw it in the air, and it caused festering boils on humans and animals.
text_cn: 他们就取了炉灰站在法郎面前；梅瑟将灰向天扬起，人和牲畜身上便起了红疹和脓疮。

text_en: The magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils, for the boils afflicted the magicians as well as all the Egyptians.
text_cn: 巫士们因为生了疮，不能站在梅瑟面前，因为巫士和一切埃及人身上都生了疮。

text_en: But the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he would not listen to them, just as the Lord had spoken to Moses.
text_cn: 上主使法郎心硬，法郎仍不肯听梅瑟和亚郎的话，正如上主向梅瑟说过的。

text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning and present yourself before Pharaoh, and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord , the God of the Hebrews: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“明天早晨你去见法郎，向他说：上主，希伯来人的天主这样说：你要放走我的百姓，使他们去崇拜我。

text_en: For this time I will send all my plagues upon you yourself, and upon your officials, and upon your people, so that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.
text_cn: 因为这一次我要使我的一切灾祸降到你、你的臣仆和你的人民身上，为叫你知道全世界上没有相似我的。

text_en: For by now I could have stretched out my hand and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth.
text_cn: 现在如果我伸手用瘟疫打击你和你的人民，你早已从地上消灭了。

text_en: But this is why I have let you live: to show you my power, and to make my name resound through all the earth.
text_cn: 我所以保留你的原故，是为叫你看见我的能力，向全世界传扬我的名。

text_en: You are still exalting yourself against my people, and will not let them go.
text_cn: 你若仍然固执压迫我的百姓，不放走他们，

text_en: Tomorrow at this time I will cause the heaviest hail to fall that has ever fallen in Egypt from the day it was founded until now.
text_cn: 看我明天此时要降下可怕的冰雹，是埃及建国以来直到现在所未有过的。

text_en: Send, therefore, and have your livestock and everything that you have in the open field brought to a secure place; every human or animal that is in the open field and is not brought under shelter will die when the hail comes down upon them. ’”
text_cn: 所以你快派人把你的牲畜和你田野间的一切，带到安全地方，因为凡在田野间的人和牲畜而不聚到屋内的，冰雹必降在他们身上，将他们砸死。”

text_en: Those officials of Pharaoh who feared the word of the Lord hurried their slaves and livestock off to a secure place.
text_cn: 法郎的臣仆中凡害怕上主的话的，就叫自己的奴仆和牲畜逃避到家中；

text_en: Those who did not regard the word of the Lord left their slaves and livestock in the open field.
text_cn: 那不把上主的话放在心上的，就将奴仆和牲畜舍在田野。

text_en: The Lord said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward heaven so that hail may fall on the whole land of Egypt, on humans and animals and all the plants of the field in the land of Egypt. ”
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“向天伸开你的手，使冰雹降在埃及全国，降在人和牲畜身上，降在埃及国内田野间的植物上。”

text_en: Then Moses stretched out his staff toward heaven, and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and fire came down on the earth. And the Lord rained hail on the land of Egypt;
text_cn: 梅瑟把他的棍杖向天一伸，上主便叫打雷，下雹，闪电打在地上。上主使冰雹降在埃及地时，

text_en: there was hail with fire flashing continually in the midst of it, such heavy hail as had never fallen in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
text_cn: 冰雹和冰雹中夹杂着不停的闪电，情形极其可怕，是全埃及国自从有人民以来所没有过的。

text_en: The hail struck down everything that was in the open field throughout all the land of Egypt, both human and animal; the hail also struck down all the plants of the field, and shattered every tree in the field.
text_cn: 冰雹把埃及全境，田野间所有的一切，连人和牲畜都打死了，打坏了田野间的一切蔬菜，打断了郊野的一切树木；

text_en: Only in the land of Goshen, where the Israelites were, there was no hail.
text_cn: 只有以色列子民所居住的哥笙地没有冰雹。

text_en: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “This time I have sinned; the Lord is in the right, and I and my people are in the wrong.
text_cn: 法郎打发人召梅瑟和亚郎来，对他们说：“这次我犯了罪，上主是正义的，我和我的人民都有罪过。

text_en: Pray to the Lord ! Enough of God’s thunder and hail! I will let you go; you need stay no longer. ”
text_cn: 请你们祈求上主！天主的雷和冰雹已够受了；我决放走你们，你们不要再留在这里。”

text_en: Moses said to him, “As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will stretch out my hands to the Lord ; the thunder will cease, and there will be no more hail, so that you may know that the earth is the Lord ’s.
text_cn: 梅瑟回答他说：“我出城后，就向上主伸手，雷必会停止，冰雹也不再降下，为叫你知道，大地是属于上主的。

text_en: But as for you and your officials, I know that you do not yet fear the Lord God. ”
text_cn: 但是我知道，你和你的臣仆，仍不敬畏上主天主。”

text_en: (Now the flax and the barley were ruined, for the barley was in the ear and the flax was in bud.
text_cn: 麻和大麦都被打坏，因为大麦已经吐穗，麻也开花，

text_en: But the wheat and the spelt were not ruined, for they are late in coming up. )
text_cn: 只是小麦和粗麦，因为长的迟些，没有被打坏。

text_en: So Moses left Pharaoh, went out of the city, and stretched out his hands to the Lord ; then the thunder and the hail ceased, and the rain no longer poured down on the earth.
text_cn: 梅瑟离开法郎出了城，向上主伸手，雷和雹就停止了，雨也不往地上下了。

text_en: But when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunder had ceased, he sinned once more and hardened his heart, he and his officials.
text_cn: 法郎见雨、雹、雷都停止了，又再犯罪，他和他的臣仆又心硬了。

text_en: So the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he would not let the Israelites go, just as the Lord had spoken through Moses.
text_cn: 法郎更加心硬，不肯放走以色列子民，正如上主藉梅瑟所说的。
